messages:
maria: quick ping — opened PR #2894 to adjust streaming client for tool-calls. main change: switch to chunked frames + add backpressure handling. would love a quick review before this afternoon's merge window. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2894 :pray:

noah: on my list, will skim now. do we think this is fully backward compatible? any chance it changes existing sync client semantics? :eyes:

maria: good q. initial behavior could change for long-running tool outputs. i added a feature-flag (toolcall_chunked) defaulting to false to preserve current behavior, and a migration note in the changelog. also added unit tests. CI is failing one flaky test tho — see snippet below from linux/mac matrix: 

```
=== FAIL: streaming/test_toolcall_timeout.py::test_timeout_race ===
E   AssertionError: expected timeout hit before finish, got completed
E   Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/streaming/test_toolcall_timeout.py", line 42, in test_timeout_race
    assert state.timed_out
```

maria: i've been trying to reproduce locally but worth a review on the logic and the new flag placement.

deploy-bot: CI: linux-x86 passed, macos-arm failed, integration-3 timed out (job 4523).

sam: i'll take a look after standup (in ~30m). pinging @noah for API compatibility check since you changed rest-client streaming earlier.

noah: quick skim — looks reasonable. two notes: 1) preserve old frame parsing as long as toolcall_chunked=false; 2) suggest adding a small e2e that exercises kv-cache preservation across chunk boundaries. otherwise 👍

maria: added e2e per note 2 and updated parser to be explicit about boundary conditions. pushed. also added changelog snippet under docs/changes.md. requesting 2 approvals for merge window at 17:00 PT.

priya: left a comment about mapping HTTP 499 -> SDK-specific ToolCallTimeout error in the PR thread. small change, but important for downstream clients. will re-review after update. :eyes:

chris: looked through the code, tests make sense. fixed a minor nomenclature nit in a follow-up commit. approving now. :shipit:

noah: approved. i still want to follow up on an observability tag for chunked frames but that can be a separate PR.

maria: thanks — i'll merge once mac CI is green or when we hit the merge window if flaky passes. will open follow-up for observability.

deploy-bot: GitHub: PR #2894 marked for auto-merge when CI passes.
